```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
library(dplyr)
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(knitr)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r run}
outcome_col <- "birth_bool"
predictors  <- c("age_model", "amh", "afc")
k_folds  <- 10
n_repeat <- 5
eps      <- 1e-4

df_lb <- readr::read_rds("data/models/df_lb_train.rds")
df_lb[[outcome_col]] <- as.numeric(df_lb[[outcome_col]])

clip_prob <- function(x, e = eps) pmax(pmin(x, 1 - e), e)

calib_coefs <- function(y, p) {
  p <- clip_prob(p)
  fit <- suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ qlogis(p), family = binomial))
  c(intercept = unname(coef(fit)[1]), slope = unname(coef(fit)[2]))
}

score_preds <- function(y, p) {
  p   <- clip_prob(p)
  auc <- as.numeric(pROC::roc(y, p, quiet = TRUE)$auc)
  br  <- mean((p - y)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  cc  <- calib_coefs(y, p)
  c(auc = auc, brier = br,
    cal_intercept = cc[["intercept"]], cal_slope = cc[["slope"]])
}

two_way_terms <- combn(predictors, 2, FUN = function(v) paste(v, collapse = ":"))
two_way_subsets <- do.call(c, lapply(0:length(two_way_terms),
  function(k) combn(two_way_terms, k, simplify = FALSE)))

build_formula <- function(interaction_terms) {
  rhs <- paste(c(predictors, interaction_terms), collapse = " + ")
  list(formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~", rhs)),
       label   = if (length(interaction_terms) == 0) "main effects only"
                 else paste(interaction_terms, collapse = " + "))
}

candidates <- lapply(two_way_subsets, build_formula)
candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
  formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~ age_model * amh * afc")),
  label   = "full 3-way: age_model * amh * afc (deployed)")

cv_one_formula <- function(form, data) {
  rep_scores <- vector("list", n_repeat)
  for (r in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    set.seed(1000 + r)
    folds <- caret::createFolds(factor(data[[outcome_col]]), k = k_folds, list = TRUE)
    oof_pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))
    for (f in folds) {
      fit <- suppressWarnings(glm(form, data = data[-f, , drop = FALSE], family = binomial))
      oof_pred[f] <- predict(fit, newdata = data[f, , drop = FALSE], type = "response")
    }
    ok <- !is.na(oof_pred)
    rep_scores[[r]] <- score_preds(data[[outcome_col]][ok], oof_pred[ok])
  }
  m <- do.call(rbind, rep_scores); mu <- colMeans(m); sdv <- apply(m, 2, sd)
  c(auc = mu[["auc"]], auc_sd = sdv[["auc"]], brier = mu[["brier"]],
    cal_intercept = mu[["cal_intercept"]],
    cal_slope = mu[["cal_slope"]], cal_slope_sd = sdv[["cal_slope"]])
}

results_tbl <- lapply(candidates, function(cand) {
  full_fit <- suppressWarnings(glm(cand$formula, data = df_lb, family = binomial))
  cv <- cv_one_formula(cand$formula, df_lb)
  data.frame(
    model         = cand$label,
    n_params      = full_fit$rank,
    cv_auc        = round(cv[["auc"]], 4),
    cv_auc_sd     = round(cv[["auc_sd"]], 4),
    cv_brier      = round(cv[["brier"]], 4),
    cal_intercept = round(cv[["cal_intercept"]], 4),
    cal_slope     = round(cv[["cal_slope"]], 4),
    cal_slope_sd  = round(cv[["cal_slope_sd"]], 4),
    AIC           = round(AIC(full_fit), 1),
    BIC           = round(BIC(full_fit), 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cal_slope_flag = dplyr::case_when(
      cal_slope >= 0.80 & cal_slope <= 1.20 ~ "OK",
      cal_slope >= 0.60 & cal_slope <= 1.50 ~ "review",
      TRUE                                  ~ "action needed"
    ),
    cal_int_flag = dplyr::case_when(
      abs(cal_intercept) <= 0.20 ~ "OK",
      abs(cal_intercept) <= 0.50 ~ "review",
      TRUE                       ~ "action needed"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(cv_auc))

dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(results_tbl, "outputs/live_birth_interaction_search.csv")

kable(results_tbl)
```
